ch0227_00_saturn/0101_0701_02_10: Hmph! Don’t look so pathetic in front of me!
ch0227_00_saturn/7101_0701_01_10:
Since my arrival on Pasio, I’ve come to know
my boss’s true desire.
ch0227_00_saturn/7101_0701_02_10:
What Master Cyrus desires is a world
without any human spirit.
ch0227_00_saturn/7101_0701_03_10:
I doubt anyone else would want a world
like that.
ch0227_00_saturn/7102_0701_01_10:
Do you know what’s important for making
ideals a reality?
ch0227_00_saturn/7102_0701_02_10:
A healthy body and spirit! There is no better
boon than that!
ch0227_00_saturn/7102_0701_03_10:
That is why Team Galactic grants free drinks,
naps anytime, and a kitchen with unlimited
access!
ch0227_00_saturn/7103_0701_01_10:
With Team Galactic’s scientific prowess,
even evolving a Poryphone is possible!
ch0227_00_saturn/7103_0701_02_10:
I shall call it the Pory2phone. Well? Piqued
your interest?
ch0227_00_saturn/7103_0701_03_10:
By the way, there would be no warranty
after the update. All responsibility would fall
to the device’s owner.
ch0227_00_saturn/7104_0701_01_10:
My partner Pokémon is composed and
follows orders faithfully.
ch0227_00_saturn/7104_0701_02_10:
It may only be natural to be drawn to a
Pokémon like oneself.
ch0227_00_saturn/7104_0701_03_10:
That applies to you and your partner. You
share the same eyes.
ch0227_00_saturn/7105_0701_01_10:
[Name:PlayerNickname ], have you ever
thought about your sense of justice or ideals?
ch0227_00_saturn/7105_0701_02_10:
At times, the ideals deep in your heart may
contradict your sense of justice.
ch0227_00_saturn/1701_0701_01_10: You can have this. Be grateful.
ch0227_00_saturn/1701_0702_01_10:
Think of this as Team Galactic’s way of
showing hospitality.
ch0227_00_saturn/2501_0701_02_10:
I suppose it doesn’t matter, as long as you
aren’t impeding Team Galactic.
ch0227_00_saturn/2501_0701_03_10:
If you ever try to interfere, you’ll have to
answer to me—every time.
ch0227_00_saturn/2501_0702_01_10:
Before, I felt considerable doubts about
Master Cyrus’s actions. Now, those doubts
are gone.
ch0227_00_saturn/2501_0702_02_10: My heart is with my boss’s ideals.
ch0227_00_saturn/2511_0701_01_10:
My boss’s greatest weapon is his
overwhelming charisma.
ch0227_00_saturn/2511_0701_02_10:
His confident, logical way of speaking melts
people’s hearts.
ch0227_00_saturn/2511_0701_03_10:
I doubt you will be able to resist the
dazzling light Team Galactic emits.
ch0227_00_saturn/2511_0702_01_10:
Without Master Cyrus, there would be no
one to lead Team Galactic.
ch0227_00_saturn/2511_0702_02_10:
That is precisely why I want to see his
accomplishments to the end.
ch0227_00_saturn/3001_0701_01_10:
Today should be another productive day for
Team Galactic...as long as you don’t
interfere.
ch0227_00_saturn/3003_0701_01_10:
Nobody is able to stem the flow of time.
Be sure to use yours wisely.
ch0227_00_saturn/3005_0701_01_10:
Team Galactic will lead this world and shine
upon it like the stars above us.
